hero.title: Train smarter. Your spotter plans, guides and cheers.
hero.body: Answer a few questions and get a plan built around your goal, time and equipment. Then follow guided workouts with video, track real progress and keep going with an AI coach that adapts when life does.
hero.note: No card needed · Works in your browser · {n} languages
hero.chipCoach: Too hard? One tap to adjust

how.title: From first question to first rep in minutes

quiz.title: Tell us about you
quiz.body: A short, friendly quiz: your goal, level, equipment, days and the coach style you like.

plan.title: Get a plan that fits
plan.body: Your weekly schedule is built from your answers, with sessions, rest and recovery days.

train.title: Train with a spotter
train.body: Follow each exercise with video, log sets, and let the app adapt the rest of the workout.

features.title: Everything you need to keep showing up

workout.title: A video for every exercise
workout.body: Each move plays on a loop with the sets, reps and rest next to it. Log a set in one tap, or say it out loud.

awards.title: See your progress, feel the wins
awards.body: Levels, streaks, personal records and badges turn consistency into something you can see.

points.1: Levels and XP for every session

community.title: Stay accountable with people
community.body: Find buddies at your level, see their streaks and keep each other honest with quick messages.

nutrition.title: Small habits that add up
nutrition.body: Simple daily targets for calories, protein and water, with meal ideas that fit your goal.

points.2: One-tap water tracking with a safe limit

adapt.title: Adapts when you do
adapt.body: Too hard, tired or short on time? Make it easier, trim to 20 minutes or swap an exercise. Completed sets are always kept.

coach.title: An AI coach that knows your plan
coach.body: Ask what to train, why, or how to change it. Pick a style: calm, direct or playful.

safe.title: Safety first
safe.body: Feeling unwell? Stop in one tap and get clear guidance. Estimates are for planning, not medical advice.

spotty.title: Meet Spotty
spotty.body: Your pocket spotter. Spotty cheers your first rep, reacts to your answers and keeps the mood light, so training feels like a habit, not a chore.

pricing.title: Start free. Go further when you want
pricing.note: No payment is taken in this version. It shows how Premium would work.

q1.a: No. You choose what you have, from nothing to a full gym, and the plan is built around it.

q2.q: I'm a complete beginner. Is this for me?
q2.a: Yes. The quiz sets your level, and every exercise has a how-to video, tips and common mistakes.

q3.q: Can I change the plan later?
q3.a: Anytime. Adjust a workout, move it, skip it or ask the coach to rebuild your week.

q4.a: Your progress is stored in your browser. Photos stay on your device and are never uploaded.

q5.a: No. Spotter AI gives general training guidance. If you have a health condition or feel unwell, talk to a professional.

cta.title: Your first workout is five minutes away
cta.body: Take the quiz, get your plan and start with a spotter by your side.

footer.disclaimer: General fitness guidance, not medical advice.
